mechanism: Amitriptyline inhibits reuptake of norepinephrine and serotonin while lisdexamfetamine increases release of these monoamines, creating combined sympathomimetic and serotonergic effects with increased cardiovascular and CNS stimulation risk.
action: Monitor closely for hypertension, tachycardia, arrhythmias, and serotonin syndrome; consider alternative stimulant or antidepressant; dose adjustments may be necessary with baseline and periodic vital sign monitoring.
